SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hrm_person WHERE reg_dtm >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND reg_dtm < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month'

WITH months AS ( SELECT generate_series( DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS month_start ), registrations AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', reg_dtm) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS count FROM hrm_person WHERE reg_dtm >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months' AND reg_dtm < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', reg_dtm) ) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(r.count, 0) AS count FROM months m LEFT JOIN registrations r ON r.month_start = m.month_start ORDER BY m.month_start

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.service_status_code, ''), '') AS code, COALESCE(c.code_name, NULLIF(p.service_status_code, ''), '미분류') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM hrm_person p LEFT JOIN com_code c ON c.code = p.service_status_code AND c.parent_code = '101' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.service_status_code, ''), ''), COALESCE(c.code_name, NULLIF(p.service_status_code, ''), '미분류') ORDER BY count DESC, code

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.employment_type_code, ''), '') AS code, COALESCE(c.code_name, NULLIF(p.employment_type_code, ''), '미분류') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM hrm_person p LEFT JOIN com_code c ON c.code = p.employment_type_code AND c.parent_code = '104' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.employment_type_code, ''), ''), COALESCE(c.code_name, NULLIF(p.employment_type_code, ''), '미분류') ORDER BY count DESC, code

SELECT COALESCE(d.dept_cd, '') AS "departmentCode", COALESCE(d.dept_nm, '미분류') AS department, COUNT(*) AS "staffCount" FROM hrm_person p LEFT JOIN hrm_org_dept d ON d.dept_cd = p.dept_cd AND d.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE p.service_status_code = '101-010' GROUP BY COALESCE(d.dept_cd, ''), COALESCE(d.dept_nm, '미분류') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, department, "departmentCode"
